aitmpl-skills.description: Example of Skills over MCP (needs Claude Code 2.1.331 or later): a remote MCP server that serves skills instead of tools. Claude Code lists them as aitmpl-skills:component-review (review a Claude Code component before sharing it) and aitmpl-skills:skill-over-mcp (build your own MCP server that serves skills). Read-only, no sign-in.

aitmpl-skills.name: component-review
aitmpl-skills.description: Review a Claude Code component (agent, command, skill, hook, MCP server config or setting) before sharing it or sending it to aitmpl.com.

aitmpl-skills.name: skill-over-mcp
aitmpl-skills.description: Build an MCP server that serves skills (Skills over MCP, extension io.modelcontextprotocol/skills) with the official TypeScript SDK.
